lines: Five-year trajectory sourced from SEC 10-K filings and FFIEC Call Reports [E-001, E-004, E-005, E-006, E-032]. Trend: STABLE with ACCELERATING commercial lending. Asset CAGR 2020–2024: 7.9%. Loan CAGR 2020–2024: 6.2%.
Total loans +5.0% YoY ($1.973B → $2.071B) — commercial loan growth the primary driver (Capital Bank C&I milestone $1.1B, Canal Bank launch) [E-001]
Net interest margin compressed 9bps (2.85% → 2.76%) — reflects industry-wide rate environment pressure on liability-sensitive community banks [E-001, E-004]
Efficiency ratio deteriorated 269bps (66.20% → 68.89%) — data processing cost +$253K (new contracts, cybersecurity), partially offset by outsourcing savings [E-001]
WMG AUA $2.212B (record) — WMG fee income $11.6M (+10.6% YoY) — fee income growth offsetting NIM compression [E-001, E-040]
5-Year Asset CAGR 2020–2024: 7.9% | 5-Year Loan CAGR: 6.2% | Trend: STABLE-GROWING [E-001, E-004, E-005, E-006]

5-year growth with CAGR calculated. Trend classification: STABLE-GROWING with ACCELERATING commercial lending trajectory. All data sourced from SEC 10-K filings and FFIEC Call Reports [E-001, E-004, E-005, E-006, E-032].

ASSET GROWTH (7.9% CAGR): Driven by Fort Orange Financial integration (Capital Bank), consistent commercial loan expansion, and now Canal Bank de novo launch. Well above US community bank median CAGR (~4%) for $2-4B peers. [E-001]

LOAN GROWTH ACCELERATION (2022-2024): $1.518B → $2.071B = +36% in 3 years. Capital Bank C&I milestone $1.1B; Canal Bank Year 1 growth exceeded expectations. Commercial pipeline remains strong. [E-001, E-022]
NIM COMPRESSION SIGNAL: NIM declined from 3.12% (2020) to 2.76% (2024) = 36bps over 5 years. Liability-sensitive balance sheet exposed to rate environment. ALCO actively managing IRR. [E-001, E-103]

EFFICIENCY RATIO PRESSURE: Rose to 68.89% (2024) from 66.20% (2023) — 269bps deterioration. Data processing expense +$253K YoY due to new contracts and cybersecurity spend. Fiserv renewal + outsourcing = management response. [E-001]

WMG ACCELERATION: $2.212B AUA (record) vs ~$1.8B in 2020 = +23% in 5 years. Fee income $11.6M (+10.6% YoY). Fee income growth is the strategic offset to NIM compression — Zennify FSC multiplier opportunity. [E-001, E-040]
